CHAPTER 318A
SECURITIES 2001-13.
An Act
(a) to establish a securities commission;
(b) to make better provision for the regulation of the securities
market and the capital market;
(c) to make better provision for the protection of investors; and
(d) to provide for related matters.
[2nd August, 2001] Commence-
ment.

Citation
1. This Act may be cited as the Securities Act. Short title.
Interpretation

"associate", where used to indicate a relationship with any person,
means
(a) an issuer of securities which the person beneficially owns
or controls, directly or indirectly voting securities entitling
the person to more than 10 per cent of the voting rights
attached to voting securities of the issuer for the time being
outstanding

(e) any other relative of the person or of his spouse if that

"association of securities companies" means an organisation of

(c) regulates the entry of any person into, or the prices for

"book entry" or "book entry accounting" means the process of

physical transfer of securities, by way of a computerised
accounting system;
"broker" means a person engaged in the business of effecting
transactions in securities for the account of others;

(a) means an option to demand delivery of a specified number
or amount of securities at a fixed price within a specified

option or the right to acquire;
"Central Bank" means the Central Bank of Barbados established by
the Central Bank of Barbados Act; Cap. 323C.
"clearing agency" means a person that
(a) acts as an intermediary in paying funds or delivering
securities, or both, in connection with sales in securities;
and
(b) provides facilities for the clearing of trades in securities;
but does not include a securities company or financial institution

business unless the Commission prescribes otherwise;
"Commission" means the Securities Commission established by
section 3;
"Commissioner" means a member of the Commission;
"control" means the possession, whether directly or indirectly, of the
power to direct or cause the direction of the management and
policies of a person, whether through the ownership of voting
securities or otherwise;
"Court" means the High Court;
"dealer" means a person engaged in the business of buying and selling
securities for his own account;
"Depository" means the Barbados Central Securities Depository
Inc. a company incorporated under the Companies Act; Cap. 308.

"insider" means
(a) an issuer in respect of its securities;
(b) an affiliate of an issuer;
(c) a director, officer or employee of an issuer;
(d) a person who beneficially owns more than 10 per cent of the
equity securities of an issuer or who exercises control or
direction over more than 10 per cent of the votes attached to

(e) any person whose relationship to the issuer gives him

"investment adviser" means a person engaging in, or holding himself

"market actor" means a person registered or deemed to be registered

(a) means a change in the business operations, assets or

(b) includes a decision to implement such a change made by

"material fact", where used in relation to securities issued or proposed

(a) a fact that significantly affects or could reasonably affect

(b) a fact that a reasonable investor takes into account or ought
to take into account when making an investment or voting
decision;
"Minister" means the Minister responsible for Finance;
"misrepresentation" means
(a) an untrue statement of a material fact; or

(b) by means of an announcement or notification in a

(c) by means of another form of publicity that is likely to bring
it to the attention of a reasonable investor, within a
reasonable time for it to be generally disseminated to
investors or within such time as the Commission may
prescribe under section 13(e);
